aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.description: Software developer focused on fullstack work. I write code that runs in production, not just in demos.

items.content: Fullstack Engineering. React, Next.js, Node.js, and FastAPI. I own the full stack — schema design, API contracts, frontend state, and deployment.
AI Integration. I connect LLMs to real data through structured APIs, prompt design, and tool-based workflows. Not wrappers — integrations that solve specific problems inside an existing system.
Linux & Workflow. Fedora Linux as my daily driver. I care about reproducible environments, clean git history, and CI/CD pipelines that behave the same way twice.

content.title: About
content.subtitle: Software that runs in production, not just in demos.
content.bio: Software developer based in Argentina. I handle the full stack: database schema, API design, React frontends, and deployment. On the AI side, I build integrations where the model has access to real context — not generic completions. I care about the architecture before I care about the model.
content.details: I work on Fedora Linux, keep a clean git history, and write tests before things break in production. If you need someone who can own a feature from the first migration to the last deploy, reach out.
